purpose: Define images, CSS, fonts, icons and other web assets as explicit logical asset identities separate from filenames, URLs and storage locations.

topics.name: Expose Web Asset Identity
topics.purpose: Define images, CSS, fonts, icons and other web assets as explicit logical asset identities separate from filenames, URLs and storage locations.

semantics.identity_rule: Each managed web asset has an explicit identity.
semantics.hash_rule: Integrity/hash evidence may identify a content revision but does not replace logical asset identity unless explicitly content-addressed.
semantics.usage_rule: Page/style/MetaModule usage references exact asset identity.
semantics.version_rule: Asset revisions are explicit where needed.
semantics.authority_rule: Asset visibility grants no edit/delete authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: filename used as semantic asset identity
URL change creates unrelated asset accidentally
page infers asset by nearest filename
